fusions.name: Three Courses Served
fusions.desc: Snaps 3 tails out in a spread to 6 tiles; each deals 3 damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Morsel Snatched
fusions.desc: Snatches at an enemy at or below 30% health with the tip, which deals 24 damage, and you heal for 40% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Reach for Every Plate
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Its healing rises 8% for each ally near you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Whetted Appetite
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
